# Cat Ski 1989

> A free browser game inspired by SkiFree (1991). Play as a cat skiing down an endless mountain. Three regional themes, mid-air tricks, dog and snowman chasers, tunable difficulty, a 9-lives casual mode that is on by default, and a local high-score leaderboard split by lives mode. No build step or install required. Last updated 12 October 2026.

Cat Ski 1989 is an open-source browser game inspired by SkiFree, with a cat as the player character. It includes three mountain themes (Alps, Rockies, Himalayas), four cat variants (black, tabby, calico, orange), chained mid-air tricks (Meow Roll, Whisker Twist, Cat Nap), gold escape ramps, regional dog breeds, and a snowman in the role of the original yeti. The snowman appears 20–40 seconds after the final dog wave clears. Each catch costs a life; losing the last life ends the run.

Difficulty uses two sliders (intensity 0.8x to 5x, dog count 1 to 10) and four presets (Easy, Medium, Hard, Insta Death). Nine lives are enabled by default, with a toggle for 1-life classic. Each lives mode has a separate top-3 leaderboard in the browser's localStorage, filled by saved runs. An optional nickname of up to five characters can be entered after a qualifying run. The game also supports synthesized sound effects, English and rioplatense Spanish, per-difficulty best scores, and installation as a Progressive Web App for offline play.

## Controls

Press Space or tap the start screen to begin. Left/right arrows or A/D steer; up/W slows down; down/S tucks for speed. Keys 1, 2, and 3 perform tricks while airborne. Space starts, retries, or resumes; P or Esc pauses or resumes; R restarts the current run. On touchscreens, drag the joystick left/right to steer, up to slow down, or down to tuck. Tap trick buttons while airborne; SWAP exchanges their position with the joystick.

## Pages

- [Play Cat Ski](https://ski.unwoke.ninja/): The game itself. Loads in a browser and is playable on desktop or mobile. Press SPACE on desktop or tap on mobile to start.
- [How to play](https://ski.unwoke.ninja/readme.html): Quick start, controls, gameplay details, installation, local scores, and privacy notes.
- [Build story](https://unwoke.ninja/cat-ski/built-with-ai/): How the game was built with an AI coding agent: the game loop, dog-ramp maths, procedural sprites, mountain palettes, and static hosting.
- [Cat Ski vs SkiFree](https://unwoke.ninja/cat-ski/skifree/): How Cat Ski compares with the original 1991 game.

## About the project

- Author: Mike Lee (Whisker Leaks)
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mikelee89/
- Source code: https://github.com/ashtonmorrow/cat-ski
- License: open source (see repository)
- Inspiration: SkiFree (1991, Microsoft Entertainment Pack 3 for Windows 3.0)
- Stack: vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in index.html; HTML5 Canvas (360x270 internal, scaled with image-rendering: pixelated); Web Audio API for procedural sound; sprites drawn in code; separate icons, preview image, and self-hosted fonts; no build step or framework
- Hosting: Vercel behind Cloudflare, deployed automatically from the GitHub repository
- Game backend: none. The leaderboard is per-browser localStorage; there are no accounts or shared score database
- PWA: installable through the INSTALL button when supported, or the browser's Add to Home Screen option; a service worker caches game assets for offline play
- Analytics: Google Analytics 4 on the game and help pages; Mixpanel game events after acceptance of the analytics banner. GA Consent Mode defaults to denied analytics storage but can still send cookieless measurements

## Privacy

No accounts or email addresses are requested. Preferences, best scores, leaderboard entries, optional nicknames, and the consent choice are saved in localStorage. The game does not include nicknames in analytics. After acceptance, Mixpanel receives game events and run statistics such as score, distance, difficulty, and leaderboard rank, associated with a generated device identifier. GA analytics cookies remain disabled until acceptance; cookieless measurements may be sent before a choice or after declining. Sharing a run is a separate player action. Clearing browser site data resets saved scores, preferences, and the consent choice. Details: https://ski.unwoke.ninja/readme.html#privacy
